html:
If you would like to know how to apply privacy window film, the best thing to do is speak with a window tinting expert. Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network and has been providing tinting services in Australia for over 40 years. In addition to privacy, our range of films provides some fantastic benefits for your home or office.

Below is information on how you can find out how to install privacy window film and why installing privacy window film is a great investment for your home or office.

Why Install One Way Window Film

There are so many benefits when it comes to installing one way window film in your home or office. The first is privacy – by choosing a more reflective film your windows turn into a mirror, so those on the outside can’t see in so you get maximum privacy during the day. You can have the ultimate in daytime privacy without losing your view because our one-way films continue to allow natural light into your home or office and they remove the need to use blinds or curtains to prevent people from seeing in.

One way window film is perfect for:

  • Homes overlooking neighbours
  • Bathrooms
  • Street facing rooms

Other benefits of our one-way window films are that your home stays cooler in the summer months and cosier during winter. You’ll notice a positive difference to your power bills! Window tinting can also help protect your flooring & furnishing and most importantly you and your family from the damage caused by harmful UV rays.

We also offer a lifetime warranty for residential applications and up to 15 years for commercial applications. When speaking with our team you can also find out more about our interest-free payment options using Openpay.
